summary: Build practical governance, stewardship, and data quality skills in 5 days. Learn with templates, scorecards, and action plans.
lede: Data governance and stewardship establish practical ways to manage data ownership, quality, and accountability. This course is for professionals who own, steward, manage, or rely on business data; it covers assessing governance maturity and assigning ownership, designing data quality controls, and maintaining metadata and issue-escalation workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, steward, manage, or rely on business data and need a practical approach to governance, quality, and accountability.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of business data processes, reporting workflows, and basic data quality concepts. You do not need programming experience, but you should be comfortable reviewing data dictionaries, issue logs, and governance templates. A laptop is recommended for hands-on exercises using spreadsheets, sample stewardship registers, and governance dashboards. The course is taught at an intermediate level, with operational application of governance methods and conceptual awareness of advanced AI-assisted classification workflows.
